x-formulaRef: Numerical Electromagnetics Code (NEC) — Method of Moments, G. J. Burke and A. J. Poggio, Naval Ocean Systems Center TD 116 (1981)

solveMode.x-tooltip: Instant is a closed-form textbook model of a preset. Standard solves your geometry with NEC-2 at one frequency; Sweep solves it across a band; Optimize searches element lengths and spacings.

referenceImpedance.x-tooltip: Impedance the reported VSWR and reflection coefficient are referred to.

wires.x-tooltip: Wire segments of the antenna. Required for every mode but Instant.

feed.x-tooltip: Which wire and segment the source drives. Required for every mode but Instant.

ground.x-tooltip: Ground model: { type: free_space | perfect | finite }, with epsilonR and conductivity when finite. Absent means free space.

conductor.x-tooltip: Conductor model: { material: copper | aluminium | perfect | custom }, with conductivity when custom. Absent means copper.

optimize.x-tooltip: NSGA-II search settings (pymoo): { populationSize (8-200), generations, lengthRange, spacingRange, maxBoomLength, goals, leadGoal, buildTolerance, heightRange }. goals is a list of { figure: peakGain | frontToBack | frontToRear | vswr | elevationGain, role: optimize | threshold | off, min (gains and ratios) or max (vswr) for a threshold, reading: worst | average (vswr across a band), elevationDeg (elevationGain, over ground only) }, with at most three optimised. frontToBack is the peak against the one direction directly behind it; frontToRear against the strongest direction 90-270 degrees off it, so a deep null directly behind cannot flatter it. Omit goals to optimise gain, front-to-back and VSWR and recommend by the 2:1 rule. leadGoal names the optimised figure the recommendation ranks by. buildTolerance { mm: 0.1-50, trials: 10-200 } re-solves the designs with random element-length and position errors. heightRange [lowest, highest] (metres, feed height, over ground) also searches the mounting height. maxBoomLength (metres) caps the distance between the first and last element. Any other key is refused.

freqStart.x-tooltip: Lower bound of the band. Required in Sweep mode over frequency; in Optimize, gives the band every goal is read across.

freqStop.x-tooltip: Upper bound of the band. Required in Sweep mode over frequency; in Optimize, gives the band every goal is read across.

freqPoints.x-tooltip: How many frequencies the band has. Each costs one solve per design in Optimize.

sweepVariable.x-tooltip: What the sweep varies: frequency across the band, or the mounting height (the feed's height above the ground) at one frequency, over perfect or real ground.

heightStart.x-tooltip: The lowest mounting height of a height sweep, in metres: the feed segment's centre above the ground. The whole antenna must stay above the ground.

heightStop.x-tooltip: The highest mounting height of a height sweep, in metres.

heightPoints.x-tooltip: How many heights the sweep solves, evenly spaced; each is one solve.

antennaType.x-tooltip: Which textbook model Instant evaluates. Instant has no model for other geometries.

groundType.x-tooltip: Ground the closed-form model assumes. Instant only.

randomSeed.x-tooltip: Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design.
